purpose: Describe an unplanned action that happens through impulse or habit.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
つい + action; often てしまう
It was so funny that I laughed without meaning to.
When I go shopping, I end up buying sweets.
I let the truth slip out.
formation: つい + action; often てしまう
restrictions: Often implies mild regret or surprise at one’s own behavior.
mistake: ついに marks an eventual outcome; つい marks an unintended action.
